statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // "unknown"'); branch=$(git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "Unknown"'); time=$(date +"%H:%M:%S"); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); ctx=""; [ -n "$used" ] && ctx=" | Context: ${used}%"; [ -n "$branch" ] && branch=" [$branch]"; printf "%s%s | %s | %s%s" "$dir" "$branch" "$model" "$time" "$ctx"
